docTitle: Billing and Invoices Policy
text:
Document: Billing and Invoices Policy
Topic: billing and invoices
Owner: Accounts Team

### 
### Policy Overview
Brightwave Digital issues tax invoices on the 1st of every calendar month for ongoing retainer services and milestone-based ad spend management. All invoices are denominated in Indian Rupees (INR) and include applicable 18% GST (GSTIN: 24AAACB1234F1Z6). Payment terms are strictly net 15 days from the date of invoice issuance.
### Approved Tone
Professional, clear, reassuring, and precise regarding figures, dates, and bank details.

docTitle: Campaign Performance Concerns and Optimization Inquiries
text:
Document: Campaign Performance Concerns and Optimization Inquiries
Topic: campaign performance concerns
Owner: Account Management

### 
### Policy Overview
Brightwave Digital manages performance marketing campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, and programmatic channels. Performance fluctuations can arise due to seasonal demand shifts, auction competition, ad creative fatigue, or attribution changes. Client inquiries regarding cost-per-acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), or lead volume dips must be met with thorough root-cause audits rather than defensive explanations.
### Approved Tone
Analytical, empathetic, objective, and proactive. Avoid making unrealistic guarantees about immediate recovery.

docTitle: Campaign Performance Concerns and Optimization Inquiries
text:
Document: Campaign Performance Concerns and Optimization Inquiries
Topic: campaign performance concerns
Owner: Account Management

### Do and Don't Rules
- DO acknowledge performance drops promptly within 3 business hours during standard business days (Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST).
- DO explain the specific diagnostic step underway (search query audits, frequency checks, negative keyword analysis, landing page speed review).
- DO propose a structured 48-hour sprint plan: creative refresh, bid strategy adjustment, or audience exclusion tests.
- DON'T blame client products, landing pages, or pricing without presenting comparative benchmark data.
- DON'T commit to fixed CPA or ROAS figures without consulting the senior growth strategist.

docTitle: Campaign Performance Concerns and Optimization Inquiries
text:
Document: Campaign Performance Concerns and Optimization Inquiries

### Approved Reply Template

We monitor your account health closely and understand your concern regarding recent CPA and conversion rate trends. Our senior performance analyst is conducting an audit covering keyword quality scores, ad fatigue frequencies, and landing page bounce rates. We are preparing a 48-hour optimization roadmap which includes testing fresh high-intent creative variants and tightening audience bid thresholds. Your dedicated Account Manager will share the audit findings and schedule an action review call with you tomorrow by 3:00 PM IST."

Topic: contract and legal

### 
### Policy Overview
All client engagements with Brightwave Digital are governed by the Master Services Agreement (MSA) signed upon contract inception. Any legal notices, breach allegations, dispute filings, contract termination notices, or attorney correspondence must be handled exclusively by the General Counsel and Corporate Legal Desk (legal@brightwavedigital.in).
### Approved Tone
Formal, respectful, legally guarded, and neutral. Never concede points or promise contractual alterations.

docTitle: Data Privacy, GDPR Compliance, and Security Incident Policy
text:
Document: Data Privacy, GDPR Compliance, and Security Incident Policy
Topic: data privacy and security
Owner: Legal and Compliance

### 
### Policy Overview
Brightwave Digital complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP) and GDPR standards. We process client customer data strictly as a data processor under strict confidentiality and encryption protocols (AES-256). Any report of data deletion, subject access requests (SAR), unauthorized access, potential data leaks, or security compromises must trigger an immediate security freeze and executive escalation (SEC-PROTOCOL-1).
### Approved Tone
Utmost seriousness, rigorous confidentiality, prompt, and non-committal regarding causes until forensic audits conclude.

docTitle: Data Privacy, GDPR Compliance, and Security Incident Policy
text:
Document: Data Privacy, GDPR Compliance, and Security Incident Policy
Topic: data privacy and security
Owner: Legal and Compliance

### Do and Don't Rules
- DO acknowledge receipt immediately, confirm high-priority escalation to the Data Protection Officer (dpo@brightwavedigital.in), and supply incident ticket ID SEC-BWD-YYYY-XXXX.
- DO state that privacy rights requests (data erasure, rectification) are executed within 30 days under Section 12 of DPDP.
- DO assure the client that our security engineering unit has begun containment verification.
- DON'T speculate on vulnerabilities, acknowledge breaches, or admit fault before forensic verification.
- DON'T share logs, customer lists, or internal architecture details in unencrypted correspondence.

docTitle: Service Refund and Chargeback Evaluation Policy
text:
Document: Service Refund and Chargeback Evaluation Policy
Topic: refund policy
Owner: Accounts Team

### 
### Policy Overview
Brightwave Digital delivers customized digital marketing, media buying, and software engineering services. Because work involves upfront specialist labor and third-party media costs (Google Ads, Meta Ads), monthly retainer fees and ad budget disbursements are non-refundable once campaign assets are deployed or ad spend is consumed. Refund requests for unspent media prepayments or verified service non-delivery are evaluated under Policy REF-2026-BWD.
### Approved Tone
Objective, empathetic, firm, and compliant. Never admit liability or promise monetary settlements upfront.

Brightwave Digital executes client agreements based on a defined Statement of Work (SOW). When a client requests supplementary services—such as launching in new regional markets, adding additional social ad platforms, extra landing page builds, or custom mobile app tracking—these requests are treated as scope modifications under Change Order Protocol COP-2026.
### Approved Tone
Accommodating, structured, transparent, and commercial.

docTitle: Technical Issues, Tag Tracking, and Website Diagnostics Policy
text:
Document: Technical Issues, Tag Tracking, and Website Diagnostics Policy
Topic: technical issues (tracking, website)
Owner: Technical Team

### 
### Policy Overview
Brightwave Digital manages tracking tag implementations, Google Tag Manager (GTM) containers, Conversions API (CAPI) gateways, webhooks, and client landing page speed diagnostics. When tracking anomalies, broken event pixels, checkout drops, or site downtime occur, the technical support desk classifies the incident severity from P1 (Critical Outage) to P4 (Minor Cosmetic Fix).
### Approved Tone
Technical, prompt, reassuring, and methodical.

docTitle: Technical Issues, Tag Tracking, and Website Diagnostics Policy
text:
Document: Technical Issues, Tag Tracking, and Website Diagnostics Policy
Topic: technical issues (tracking, website)
Owner: Technical Team

### Do and Don't Rules
- DO acknowledge critical tracking or site outage incidents within 15 minutes and assign an on-call tech engineer.
- DO verify Google Tag Manager container IDs (GTM-XXXXXXX) and Meta Pixel diagnostics before committing code changes.
- DO provide a public ticket reference (format: BWD-TECH-YYYY-XXXX) and resolution estimate (P1: < 4 hours; P2: < 12 hours).
- DON'T deploy script edits directly to client production servers without testing in staging or GTM preview mode.
- DON'T speculate on external server hosting crashes before checking ping and DNS response status.
